# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-11-02):
> stock Strata v0.2.9 (engine 0.1.55) + stock OMP 18.15.0 across all three hosts and the Mac Studio route, rolling back
> to stock Strata v0.2.8 (engine 0.1.54) + stock OMP 18.14.0: on the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a`
> (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock roles `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the
> RTX 4090 as Main staged last, manual layer split 24 `--layer-split 24`, stage dense-weight trim `--trim-stage-weights`
> (`strata.trim_stage_weights: true`) growing each card's expert cache by 1.8 GiB to 19.15 GiB on the RTX 3090 and
> 17.76 GiB on the RTX 4090 vs 17.35 and 16.01 GiB without trim and keeping G17's near-limit task wall at 60.4 s vs
> 67.0 s on v0.2.8 `roles-pledirect`, pipeline windows 2, no batch slots, display on the RTX 4090, and
> `strata.ple_io: "direct"` pinning stock `--ple-io direct` to keep the 26.8 GiB per-layer embedding (PLE) table on
> direct SSD reads, preserving the engine's 8,192 MiB automatic conversation cache and 27.7 GiB Windows commit headroom
> of a 135.7 GiB limit;
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0/qualification.json);
> rolling back to `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`),
> on an RTX PRO 6000 at the trained 262,144-token context with four batch slots, per-slot multi-token prediction (MTP)
> `--batch-mtp` (`strata.batch_mtp: true`: +22.5% total output at two concurrent requests, +8% at four 2K requests and
> +40% summed decode at four 40K prompts on the v0.2.8 root), direct PLE reads `--ple-io direct`
> (`strata.ple_io: "direct"`: 35.1-39.7 s restart readiness on v0.2.9, G16 35.1 s, G20 35.1 s, G21 39.7 s, G15 kill
> recall 48.7-49.4 s, and 81.3 GiB G10 Windows commit headroom of a 219.7 GiB limit with 112.6 GiB available RAM), the
> engine's 8,192 MiB conversation parking and 32K prompt chunks
> (`win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0/qualification.json);
> rolling back to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`; the PRO's
> v0.2.9 NVFP4-QAD screen profile stays a comparison-only draft),
> and on an RTX 5090 (`rtx5090-win-a`), where the 262,144-token Coder IQ1_M profile is the host's default
> (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0/qualification.json)),
> with an unchanged 36 GiB available-RAM start floor and a 3,072 MiB automatic conversation cache (21 parks in G19; G10
> serving: 10.55 GiB available RAM, 17.55 GiB commit headroom of an 85.15 GiB limit; G16/G20/G21 restart ready in
> 16.6-16.8 s, lowest available RAM 6.56 GiB in G17). Operating condition for the RTX 5090 262K default: the host's
> Docker Desktop and WSL, which run its production NInfer container, must be stopped; after WSL restarts, that container
> must be recreated by the owner's pinned relaunch script and re-registered with the owner's fleet controller. The
> 131,072-token Coder IQ1_M profile (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0/qualification.json))
> is the qualified alternative for running with Docker Desktop and WSL up (the production container stopped by the fleet
> controller; 34 GiB start floor). Both RTX 5090 ledgers have 21 pass and 3 not applicable and roll back to their
> v0.2.8 + OMP 18.14.0 predecessors (`win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0` and
> `win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`).
> Stock Strata v0.1.40.3 + stock OMP 18.8.4 stays qualified for single-card RTX 3090 hosts
> ([ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.1.40.3-omp18.8.4/qualification.json)).
> All four server profiles roll back to v0.2.8 (engine 0.1.54) + OMP 18.14.0:
> [PRO, 262K batch-MTP + PLE-direct rollback (v0.2.8)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090, 262K default rollback (v0.2.8)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-262k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json),
> [RTX 5090, 131K alternative rollback (v0.2.8)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx5090-coder-iq1m-131k-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json),
> [pair, 262K split-24 trim + PLE-direct rollback (v0.2.8)](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/qualification.json).
> On the pair's measurement-only [v0.2.8 stock-residency roles draft](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-parking-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0/manifest.json),
> upstream's [Niko1221/Strata#4518](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/4518) fix locked the 26.8 GiB PLE table
> (33.9-34.0 s), then gave the lock back on both starts and sized the automatic conversation cache at 4,864 MiB
> (106-112 s to ready), against 8,192 MiB and 61-63 s to ready with `--ple-io direct` at matching 100K-token TTFT
> (31.2 s vs 30.9 s), so the pair keeps `--ple-io direct`. The v0.2.9 campaign is complete across all five rows;
> pinning the comparison-only v0.2.9 feature-arm winners and preparing UD-IQ4_XS and NVFP4-QAD for the owner's
> Terminal-Bench run are approved follow-up work packages, not part of the current profiles.
> The comparison-only v0.2.9 NVFP4-QAD PRO draft, the measurement-only v0.2.8 stock-residency pair draft, the held
> v0.2.7 roles draft (PLE in RAM), the unmeasured v0.2.7 default-split draft, the default and split-32 v0.2.3 pair
> drafts and the v0.1.44.1 pair release remain draft, not qualified.
> Each current local ledger has 21 pass and 3 not applicable. Cold-start version A/B against v0.2.8 (`A B B A A B`,
> `A = v0.2.8`, `B = v0.2.9`) showed aggregate output `tok/s` `B/A` ratios of 0.996-1.012 on the PRO, 0.999-1.001 on the
> RTX 5090 262K and 1.003 on the pair. Real-host v0.2.9 receipts cite tooling commits `6fec79d` on the PRO batch-MTP +
> PLE-direct main run and the RTX 5090 262K and 131K main runs, and `8002c77` on the pair split-24 trim + PLE-direct
> main run after admitting engine
> 0.1.55's stage order, with operator receipts (`276bbaa`) binding G00 to `6fec79d`, G01-G05 to the 866-test host-free
> suite at `2ccea3c` (4 skips on single-GPU lanes, 29 on the pair) and G06 to green PR #72
> [CI run 41457827645](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/actions/runs/41457827645) at `2ccea3c`.
> Scored (G24): PRO batch-MTP + PLE-direct 16/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.8 rollback: 15/18, pilot 6/6), RTX 5090 262K default
> 16/18 (pilot 6/6; v0.2.8: 17/18, pilot 6/6), RTX 5090 131K alternative 14/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.8: 18/18, pilot 5/6),
> current pair split-24 trim + PLE-direct 15/18 (pilot 5/6; v0.2.8 rollback: 15/18, pilot 5/6). Per task on the four
> current v0.2.9 profiles: tool-loop 1/3 on PRO and RTX 5090 262K, tool-loop 0/3 and bugfix-a 2/3 on RTX 5090 131K, and
> tool-loop 0/3 on pair split-24 trim + PLE-direct; every other task 3/3. Protocol counters (including malformed
> arguments and calls without results) and timeouts are 0 across all four current v0.2.9 server profiles; all task

> Scored batch walls are 576 s on PRO batch-MTP + PLE-direct (v0.2.8 rollback: 635 s), 840 s on the RTX 5090 262K
> default (v0.2.8: 865 s), 763 s on the RTX 5090 131K alternative (v0.2.8: 968 s) and 975 s on the current pair split-24

> (0.1.55) as a separately versioned CUDA 13 component tarball staged into `runtime\strata\engine\`, reusing
> `locks/strata-python-cp313-win_amd64-strata0.2.7.txt` (26 hash-locked wheels).

> keeps the display on the RTX 4090; its
> [earlier predecessor](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> requires moving the display back to the RTX 3090. Single-card RTX 3090 profiles are not rollbacks
> while both cards are installed: they name GPU 0, now the RTX 4090. Earlier qualified history: on the RTX PRO 6000, stock Strata v0.1.41 + stock OMP
> 18.8.6 with the same choices at 262,144 tokens, then at 131,072 tokens, then the same choices on v0.1.40.3 + OMP
> 18.8.4, then OMP 18.8.3, then v0.1.40.2 + 18.8.0 without them; on the RTX 5090, v0.1.41 + OMP 18.8.6, then
> v0.1.40.3 + OMP 18.8.4, then stock Strata v0.1.34 + stock OMP 18.4.10, which also stays qualified on the
> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-batchmtp-pledirect-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`,
  runs stock OMP 18.15.0 through an SSH local forward to
  `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-batchmtp-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`, the PRO's current v0.2.9 262K
  batch-MTP + PLE-direct profile. Its independent G23 passed on 2026-11-02 at `6fec79d`: missing key refused before
  launch, wrong key 401, health RTT 5.7-8.5 ms and stream TTFT 0.206 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight with the
  prior transcript preserved, and nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen (0.91 s), client restart (1.04 s) and verified
  server restart (1.51 s). Its qualified rollback,
  `client-rtxpro6000-262k-batchmtp-pledirect-strata0.2.8-omp18.14.0`, reaches the PRO's v0.2.8 262K batch-MTP +
  PLE-direct rollback (G23 pass on 2026-10-31 at `610be03`). The 0.2.8 `slots4-parking`, 0.2.7, 0.2.3, 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1,
  0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier
  history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.

- [README](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata#readme): status, what the tool does, layout, host-free checks
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): the tested install, start, use and stop commands
- [Operations](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md): lifecycle, recovery, logs, upgrades, requalifying a new tuple
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): what is and is not isolated, observed egress, known defects
- [Measurements](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/MEASUREMENTS.md): resources, throughput, context, restart cost, evaluation results
- [Decision](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/DECISION.md): integration readiness, usefulness, further investment
- [Baseline](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/BASELINE.md): the frozen component tuple and why it was chosen
- [Upstream](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/docs/UPSTREAM.md): findings reported to Strata and Oh My Pi
- [Release ledgers](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/tree/main/releases): manifest, gate ledger, receipts and scrubbed evidence per profile
